season.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/ ('The campground season is from April 10, 2026 – November 1, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Electric/water $30 a day, full hookup $35 a day (weekly $180/$210). The five separate lakeside tent sites on Volcano Road are $23 a night, first come, self-pay.

fees.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/ ('Rates: Electric/Water- $30 per day or $180 per week. Full-Hookup- $35 per day or $210 per week ... Lakeside campsites- $23 per day', on the page carrying the 2026 season) + https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/lakeside-campsite/ ('lake view from your tent'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/ ('14 full hookup sites and 64 sites with electric/water'; amperage not stated), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/ ('78 campsites suitable for tents, trailers and recreational vehicles'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/ ('Multiple bathhouses ... offering hot showers'; 'campground store when the host is on duty') + https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/reservation-policies/ (2.13 'All grey water, food debris and human waste shall be disposed of at dump station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://mountwoodpark.org/campground/reservation-policies/ (rules effective 2016-02-01, 2.1 'Campsites shall be rented on a first come, first served basis'); only the Lake House and primitive cabins take reservations (304-679-3611), read 2026-10-22

note: Wood County park about 12 miles east of Parkersburg off US-50, with ATV and bike trails and a lake; the ATV trailhead is next to the campground. Campground host 304-588-7613. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the park's own pages: 78 sites (14 full hookup, 64 water/electric, amps not given), $30/$35 a day, first come first served, hot showers, camp store, dump station; new season Apr 10 - Nov 1 (2026). Booking, sites, hookups and facilities move from derived to manual. Note trimmed of the site/hookup/facility/FCFS/season restatements.
flags: Conflicting counts on the park's own site: the Campground page says 78 sites (14 full hookup + 64 water/electric); the Camp N' Ride page says 87 sites (16 full hookup + 64 water/electric). Recorded the Campground page's 78.

The lakeside campsite page still gives a 2024 season ('April 1, 2024- October 31, 2024'); those five tent sites on Volcano Road are separate from this campground (waterfront unchanged; not a lead for the main campground).
